subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked as `check-content-paths`, docgate shall fail any system-footprint path reference (a `.pyxis/` path) in wiki entries or in the flat requirement corpus (its README included), and — when a merge base is given — in any PRD ledger entry or technical design added since the merge base; the live rollups, the root operating manual, generated artifacts, and documents present at the merge base are out of scope (rollups describe the shipped footprint; the root manual owns the pointers; frozen history is never retro-edited). Templates are cited by version pin.
rationale: the corpus must survive footprint removal interpretable (repo-layout A-2/DINV-4); the promised grep gate becomes real, scoped forward-only (#54 A5)
fit_criterion: fixtures: a wiki entry or corpus file containing a footprint path → red naming file and line; a ledger entry or design added since the merge base containing one → red; a pre-existing frozen document containing one → green; rollup and root-manual references → green; the real corpus green after the three known violations are fixed
